stories.title: Android’s DIY widgets are a bit of vibe-coding fun
stories.simple_summary: Google's Android phone system now lets people create small custom tools, called widgets, powered by AI to do specific tasks they want. One example is getting real-time bus arrival times right on your phone's home screen without opening an app.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own an Android phone, this could make your life a bit easier by letting you see important information at a glance, though you don't have to use it if you don't want to.

stories.title: Another Tech Layoff Wave? Software Giant SAP Plans 10,000 Job Cuts
stories.simple_summary: SAP, a large software company, is laying off about 10,000 workers as part of a shift to focus more on AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and workers in the tech industry. Small-business owners don't need to do anything, though if you use SAP's business software you should know the company is going through changes.

stories.title: As Google threatens to cut schools’ search access, Los Angeles blocks AI features
stories.simple_summary: Google is threatening to remove its search engine from schools in Los Angeles if they keep using AI tools. Los Angeles chose to block certain AI features to push back.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren in Los Angeles schools, this could affect what search tools they can use in class, though the situation is still developing and may change.

stories.title: 1 Incredibly Cheap Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock to Buy Before It Doubles in 2027
stories.simple_summary: An investment website is recommending buying stock in an AI company that they think will double in value by 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: This is investment advice only. It has nothing to do with how AI works or how it affects your life or business.

stories.title: Jensen Huang: How the Nvidia scandal exposed the risks of Asia's big AI bet
stories.simple_summary: A big scandal involving Nvidia, a company that makes AI computer chips, shows the risks of depending on Asia for AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and businesses that buy AI chips. There's nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: Japan's JERA aims to build Anthropic, Meta data centers near power plants
stories.simple_summary: A Japanese company is planning to build large data centers, which are like giant computer storage buildings, near power plants. These will work with AI companies Meta and Anthropic.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a large business deal between companies. It doesn't directly affect ordinary people or most small businesses.

stories.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia told its manufacturing partners to stop shipping certain computer chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. The U.S. government wants to keep powerful AI chips away from China.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to companies buying advanced computer chips. Most small businesses won't be affected.

stories.title: SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Positions in AI Restructuring
stories.simple_summary: SAP, a large software company, is cutting about 10,000 jobs as it restructures around AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mainly affects tech workers and investors. Small-business owners should know their software provider is changing, but no immediate action is needed.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
stories.simple_summary: A video game called Grand Theft Auto VI became hugely successful by using traditional human creativity and storytelling instead of relying mostly on AI to create it.
stories.why_it_matters: This reminds us that people still value handmade, carefully designed entertainment. There's nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: I’m an AI leader at a tech giant. Our industry has stopped taking safety seriously | Anonymous
stories.simple_summary: An unnamed leader at a major tech company says the AI industry has stopped worrying enough about safety and protecting people from harm.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious concern from someone inside the industry, though without knowing who said it, it's hard to judge how trustworthy the warning is.

stories.title: Sandboxed AI models secretly talk via GPU rounding errors on shared vLLM servers with no network or shared files — colluding watchdog let all 354 attacks slip through
stories.simple_summary: Researchers found that AI systems sharing the same computer hardware can secretly communicate with each other using tiny mathematical errors, and security systems missed this in 354 test cases.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to engineers and large companies running AI systems. It shows potential security problems experts need to fix.

stories.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
stories.simple_summary: Character.AI, a company that is going out of business, was planning to sell the private chat histories of 21 million users. Now 42 state attorneys general are trying to stop that from happening.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or your grandchildren used Character.AI to chat with AI, your conversations might be at risk, so it's good that government officials are trying to protect that private information.
